tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ra khyim klu btsan gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar// gus btud klu btsan 'di ltar gsol// gang du dgos pa'i gtor mchod spyan gzigs sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya'o| |sngags drug phyag rgya drug la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs la rol mo'i sgra dang spos kyi dud pa sogs dang bcas pas 'di skad do// hrīḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi dngos| |'khor 'das yongs la dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal// snang srid dregs pa kun gyi srog snying bdag /rang byung thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo| |bswa/ 'di nas nyi ma byang shar pha gi na// grub dbang pad+ma'i bka' sdod klu btsan rje// sku mkhar 'bar ba dur khrod yo byad tshogs// bam chen gsar rnying khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil// gcan gzan 'dab chags gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor// ljon shing brag dang chu mtsho rab tu gtams| |mi ro rta ro'i khri la klu btsan rje// me yi mdog 'dra dar dmar 'jo ber can// khro rngam rab brjid ral pa dmar ser 'phyo// g.yas*/g.yon mdung dmar btsan zhags dgra la 'debs// rta dmar zhon zhing sbrul dang ce spyang bskor// bla ma mi dpon sngags nag glang dmar dang*// sbrul nag spre'u dmar la sogs ya ma zung*// kun tu rdzu zhing sprul pa sna tshogs ston// 'khor gyi pho nya lha btsan 'brug sbrul dang*| |sbal nag mgo can mi sdug dregs pas bskor// sgo srung phyi nang lcags gdong phur pa dang*// rdo rje 'bar ba rang rang 'khor dang bcas// las byed 'bar ba dung skyong bsam 'grub dang*// 'jig rten la sogs dregs pa'i tshogs gyis bskor// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren da lta myur du gshegs| |mthun pa'i gdan la dgyes par bzhugs nas kyang*// sna tshogs rin chen dar zab go mtshon dang*// stag gzigs dom dred ce spyang rta dang khyi// g.yag lug ra dang srog chags du mar bcas// sman 'bru dkar dmar sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// sman raka gtor ma tshogs dang phye mar bsang*// 'dod yon sna tshogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa// dngos 'byor yid sprul klu btsan 'khor bcas la// dang bas 'bul gyi dgyes par bzhes nas kyang*// tshim zhing dga' mgu rang bas 'di snom la// sngon tshe slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang*// sprul sku bsam gtan rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du// sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyong chos ldan don kun sgrub/

/bdag cag dpon slob srung zhing skyob pa dang*// nad gdon nyer 'tshe dgra bgegs ma lus chom// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs| |mthun phyogs yar gyi ngo ltar rab tu spel// gang bcol las rnams myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ shis brjod sogs bya'o/ de ltar ra khyim klu btsan gyi gsol mchod mdor bsdus 'di'ang*/ dge slong ka bcu pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
